videos.headline: Ohio State recovers Texas' fumble on 1st play of game
Ohio State comes up big with wild INT
Ja'Kobi Jackson powers across the goal line for an Ohio State TD
Jeremiah Smith makes a great grab in traffic for an Ohio State TD
Arch Manning finds Ryan Wingo for Texas' 1st TD of the game
Hollywood Smothers' rushing TD has UT fans on their feet
Ohio State misses major FG attempt late in 4th quarter
Hollywood Smothers leaps across the goal line to give UT a lead
Texas goes wild after defeating No. 1 Ohio State
